answer: Make every claimed piece of agent work replayable: a randomly chosen peer re-runs the job from scratch and compares results, holding the output up like a crystal to check for flaws. Audit targets are drawn blind, the way walnuts are pulled from a mixed sack, so no identity knows whether its work will be re-checked. A sybil farm must then genuinely perform every clone's work - fabricated output fails its replay and forfeits the identity's stake - and the check itself follows a fixed form, a sonnet with no room to hide a missing line.
